/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('src/data/lyrics/ab-aaye-ho-baba.md')
original = path.read_bytes()
opening, rest = original.split(b'romanLyrics:', 1)
_, body = rest.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
roman = \"\"\"Wo Karbala wo shaam-e-gharibaaṅ wo tiragi
Wo Zainab-e-haziṅ wo hifaazat khiyaam ki

1
Aaya wo ek sawaar qarib-e-khiyaam-e-Shah
Beti Ali ki ghaiz mein su-e-faras barhi

2
Ulti naqaab chehre se apne sawaar ne
Pesh-e-nigaah Zainab-e-mazlum the Ali

3
Har chand saabira thi bahut bint-e-Fatema
Besaakhta zabaan par ye faryaad aa gayi

4
Zainab ne kaha baap ke qadmoṅ se lipat kar
Ab aaye ho Baba
Jab lut gaya pardes mein Ammaaṅ ka bhara ghar
Haaye - Jab lut gaya pardes mein Ammaaṅ ka bhara ghar

5
Baba agar aana hi tha khaaliq ki raza se
Us waqt na aaye
Jab khaak par dam tor raha tha mera Akbar
Haaye - Jab khaak par dam tor raha tha mera Akbar

6
Kat kat ke gire nahr pe jab baazu-e-Abbas
To koi na tha paas
Us waqt sada aap ko deta tha Dilawar
Haaye - Us waqt sada aap ko deta tha Dilawar

7
Jab farsh-e-zamin baam-e-falak larza baja tha
Us waqt kahaaṅ the
Jab baap ke chullu mein tha khun-e-Ali Asghar
Haaye - Jab baap ke chullu mein tha khun-e-Ali Asghar

8
Jab bhai ka sar katta tha main dekh rahi thi
Hazrat ko sada di
Sar khole hue roti thi main khaime ke dar par
Haaye - Sar khole hue roti thi main khaime ke dar par

9
Jab log bacha le gaye laashe shuhada ke
Haq apna jata ke
Bas ek tan-e-Shabbir ka paamaali ki zad par
Haaye - Bas ek tan-e-Shabbir ka paamaali ki zad par

10
Jab baali Sakina ke guhar chhine gaye the
Lagte the tamaanche
Hasrat se mujhe dekhti thi Baanu-e-Muztar
Haaye - Hasrat se mujhe dekhti thi Baanu-e-Muztar

11
Jab Shaam ke qazaaq hameiṅ lut rahe the
Khaimoṅ ko jala ke
Aap aa gaye hote to na chhinti meri chaadar
Haaye - Aap aa gaye hote to na chhinti meri chaadar

12
Kya aap ne Firdaus se ye dekha na hoga
Kya hashr bapa tha
Jab pusht se bimaar ki khaincha gaya bistar
Haaye - Jab pusht se bimaar ki khaincha gaya bistar

13
Ek raat ke mehmaan haiṅ phir qaid-e-salaasil
Ab aane se haasil
Baazaar mein ham subh ko jaaeṅ ge khule sar
Haaye - Baazaar mein ham subh ko jaaeṅ ge khule sar

14
Shahid rukh-e-Haidar par bikhar jaate the aansu
Jab khol ke gesu
Chillaati thiṅ Zainab mere Baba meri chaadar
Haaye - Chillaati thiṅ Zainab mere Baba meri chaadar\"\"\"
source_blocks = body.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')
roman_blocks = roman.split('\\n\\n')
assert len(source_blocks) == len(roman_blocks) == 15
assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in source_blocks] == [len(block.splitlines()) for block in roman_blocks]
for number, (source, transliteration) in enumerate(zip(source_blocks[1:], roman_blocks[1:]), 1):
    assert int(source.splitlines()[0]) == int(transliteration.splitlines()[0]) == number
assert all(char.isascii() or char in 'ṅṄ' for char in roman)
assert sum(len(block.splitlines()) for block in roman_blocks) - 14 == 52
block = '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in roman.splitlines())
updated = opening + ('romanLyrics: |-\\n' + block).encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body
path.write_bytes(updated)
assert path.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == body
PY"
